text:
Harper Lee: Quick sync  we want the release post + benchmark appendix + webinar tomorrow morning. Target publish 09:10am PT but will hold until ops confirms canary looks good. Need changelog URL and docs landing ready.

Diego Ramos: Working on changelog. Expect URL pattern /docs/changelog/v0.11. I'll ping when PR is merged. Ops, share canary timings?

docbot: Canary scheduled: 2026-04-22T08:40:00Z -> 10% at 08:40Z, 50% at 08:55Z, 100% at 09:05Z. Track /ops/deploys/17699.

Maya Khan: Marketing prefers publish 09:15am PT to leave a 10-minute buffer after full rollout. If canary pauses we hold. Also need a tiny cherrypick to fix code snippet auth header.

Diego Ramos: I'll apply the cherrypick at 08:20am PT and kick the docs build. CDN invalidation should finish by ~09:00am PT.

Sam R: Draft social copy: "Shipping Redwood Optimize v0.11: smarter batching, smarter routing. p95 down 17%, token cost down ~23%. Webinar 10am PT. Blog + benchmarks -> link in bio." Keep it short.

Harper Lee: Nice. ML can we lock the exact benchmark phrasing? We usually use precise numbers.

Diego Ramos: ML signoff received: "p95 latency improved 17% with production batching; token cost reduced ~23% on our chat mix." Add benchmark CSV to slides.

docbot: Canary stage1 complete (10%). Stage2 50% started at 08:55Z. Monitoring: OK.

Maya Khan: Great. Ops  confirm canary end time and whether we should wait extra minutes before publish?

docbot: Canary reached 100% at 09:05Z. No critical alerts. Eng-oncall monitoring green for 10m.

Diego Ramos: Changelog live: https://redwood.ai/docs/changelog/v0.11. Docs landing: https://redwood.ai/docs/release/v0.11. PR merged.

Sam R: Swapped links in CMS and scheduled publish for 09:15am PT. I'll queue social thread and webinar reminders (10m and 1m).

Harper Lee: Please attach benchmark appendix to calendar invite and update webinar slides. Also add a short FAQ about cost calc and migration.

Sam R: Appendix attached, FAQ drafted. Will post short post-launch note after webinar with metrics and top Qs.

Maya Khan: Thanks team  publishing scheduled. If anything spikes post-publish, tag eng-oncall and pause socials. :rocket:

eng-oncall: Will monitor. Alert if error rate >0.5% sustained.

Harper Lee: Closing thread  we'll collect engagement stats and lessons learned. :white_check_mark:
